your_book:
Jaleel's book slipped about 0.4% on a weighted basis today (Tuesday), and its unrealized result stands at -0.84%. The damage came from the big defensive names. Zoetis, the largest weight at 11.1%, fell 3.38%, Abbott fell 1.66% and Boston Scientific fell 1.11%. Adobe (-3.98%) and On Holding (-3.01%) also dragged. No headline explains the Zoetis drop, so treat it as unexplained. Rocket Lab's 8.39% jump cushioned the day, and Broadcom (+4.0%) and Nvidia (+0.95%) helped too.

The drift is in what is rising and what is falling. Rocket Lab (6.3% of the book) and Lululemon (4.1%) are both rated AVOID, and they are down 25.6% and 18.2% on the position. Together that is 10.4% of the book in names the framework rejects, and one strong day for Rocket Lab doesn't change that. Adobe fell while the headline says enterprise software rose on a rotation, so it is lagging its sector, which fits the AI-disruption narrative flag. The chip headline says semis fell on AI-capex worries, yet Nvidia and Broadcom both rose, so don't read much into that gap.

Next up: Boston Scientific reports on Wednesday, Oct 28. It is rated STRONG BUY but carries a slashed-guidance flag and management has guided flat through Q3. It is 9.3% of the book and down 8.0%.
